title: Progression Plus
description: Mod to increase the difficulty of armor and tool progression.
body:
Adds new templates to upgrade armor and tools like you do from diamond -> netherite with the netherite upgrade template.\
Crafting of tools and armor is disabled except wooden tools and leather armor.

# Templates
There are 6 new upgrade templates:
- Stone upgrade template
- Copper upgrade template
- Chainmail upgrade template
- Iron upgrade template
- Gold upgrade template
- Diamond upgrade template
  
The netherite upgrade template is still in the game

# Obtaining
All of the templates can be found in loot chests. Drop rates can be found in the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/progressionplusmod/gallery).

There are also crafting recipes to duplicate the templates:

### Copper upgrade template dupplication recipe with diamond blocks

# Usage
### Tool upgrading
![Tool upgrade with copper upgrade template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad5d751b95b47a8f489cb208b23e466376fd2008.png)
### Armor upgrading
![Armor upgrade with copper upgrade template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6273ac7ee35a559940eceeaa8ec506c3c4953d91.png)

### Progression path
### Tools
Wood -> Stone -> copper -> Iron -> Gold -> Diamond -> Netherite\
Wood can be crafted.

### Armor
Leather -> Copper -> Chainmail -> Iron -> Gold -> Diamond -> Netherite\
Leather can be crafted.

### Horse armor
Leather -> Copper -> Iron -> Gold -> Diamond -> Netherite\
Leather can be crafted.

### Nautilus armor
Copper -> Iron -> Gold -> Diamond -> Netherite\
No tier can be crafted.

# Stat changes to tools and armor
Normaly gold tools and armor are stat wise close to copper and stone. This mod tries to make gold and chainmail actually viable by chaning some of the stats.

### Tools
Only gold tier has some stats changed, other tiers are vanilla stats.
